Sauce & Condiment

Brown Sauce

About This Entry

Brown Sauce is a canonical British HP-style brown table sauce for breakfast and chips ingredient in global cookery — its acidity, richness, and pairing behavior pair with structured whites, aromatic rosés, and spice-friendly reds when used as a finishing or table sauce.
